facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic lists the NICI plan 2007-2027 among Chad's key policies, dated 2007, and says the government articulated this vision.
The diagnostic gives the NICI plan a period of 2007-2027.
The diagnostic says ADETIC developed the National ICT Development Strategy (Plan Tchad Numérique 2017-2021) in November 2017 and that the plan came to an end recently.
The diagnostic gives the Plan Tchad Numérique a period of 2017-2021.
The diagnostic's policy table lists the Strategic Plan of Digital and Posts Development (PSDNP 2020-2030) as a 2020 strategic plan.

facts.fact: The diagnostic gives the PSDNP a period of 2020-2030.
